size_basis: L x W x H mm, set by flow_graph/param/ess_tf.py (X-MFG-43b): the PVC-U DN100 column on its plinth
solids_note: one compound of closed solids: plinth with drain slot, shell, sump floor, perforated support plate, ring bed, distributor, demister, top cap, vent riser and the socket stubs; every union/cut partner overlaps or clears, so the mesh reads back closed and manifold

a_col.packing: 25 mm PVC-U Pall rings (in-house cut tube rings, X-MFG-32 class)
a_col.basis: A-COL: packing height, support, distributor and demister are solids; HTU and NTU stay the duty-held figures (duty section 8; W12(2)). Diameter at 1.5 m/s on the live purge the charge book re-solves (ess_tf, X-MFG-43b); the 30 m3/h / 84 mm duty figures stay the W12(1) class basis and DN100 carries the larger of the two diameters

holdup_L.basis: the nominal sump class is hardware (AQS-DUTY-061 house class), not a residence time derived from the gas mass (duty section 2 rule); reported, not used (A-VES rule)
